body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Today, Samsung Electronics announced the SMX-C20 stylish, ergonomically-designed compact digital camcorders. It features the built-in 25 degree Active Angle Lens that allows users to hold the camcorder in a more relaxed and natural position since the lens is angled downward by 25 degrees.

It also include Hyper Image Stabilization, H.264 compression, which allows you to record longer than camcorders using the typical MPEG2 format, Samsung's play-edit-sharing program called intelli studio, a one-touch "upload" button that provides a direct connection to YouTube, 230K-pixel, swiveling 2.7-inch wide LCD screen, basic on-camera editing, including the ability to merge and split video files, and unique features, including time lapse recording, animated thumbnails and a versatile charging system.

The SMX-C20 offers standard definition video recording at a resolution of 720×480 and offers the ability to capture still images at a resolution of two mega pixel, 10x optical zoom. The SMX camcorders also feature the ToC design, which has a hint of color that is naturally blended into the deep black body of the camcorders to create an attractive crystalline appearance. It will be available in February 2010.
